title: Printed visitor floor plans
slide_intent: Carry wayfinding into a portable format so visitors can continue navigating away from fixed displays.
strategic_value: A consistent printed plan can connect signage and personal route-finding.
demonstration: An angled white sheet presents labeled lower-level and ground-level floor plans with a compact lab signature.
practical_value: Study information hierarchy between floor labels, maps and directory text.
